evidence.summary: search(items, query): trims query (ECMAScript trim), lowercases, returns [] for empty needle, else items whose lowercase form includes the needle, in order.

features.name: Query trimming
features.behavior: Leading/trailing ECMAScript whitespace and line terminators (incl. BOM, NBSP, U+3000) are ignored.

features.name: Empty query
features.behavior: A query that is empty after trimming returns [].

features.name: Case-insensitive substring filter
features.behavior: Returns original items (order, duplicates and case kept) whose lowercase form contains the lowercase needle.

features.name: Unicode edge handling
features.behavior: NEL, U+001C and zero-width space are not trimmed; lowercase follows the runtime's Unicode tables.

improvements.proposal: Document Unicode lowercase differences between runtimes
improvements.benefit: Avoids silent drift on untested scripts
improvements.validation: Add cases for Turkish dotted I and Greek final sigma; diff must stay 100%
